lines: Several dark masses of flame appeared simultaneously.
「Those are will-o'-the-wisps. A magic trap, huh?!!」
As soon as Nao-senpai had set foot on the property, they appeared as if a switch had been flicked.
It was the exact same approach used when I had fought them with Jisai or Kirara-senpai previously. No doubt about it.
「Wait, what? Those monsters?! Fuuma-kun, do you know about them?」
「They're animal souls that a magic user controls. It's pointless to fight with these things. They'll appear limitlessly!」
「Right!! We have to hit the real person who's controlling the monsters!!」
As Hebiko said, will-o'-the-wisps were appearing continuously from behind us as well, thanks to the magical trap.
「They came out on a time delay, huh?!」
「（There are dogs, cats, bears... Monkeys and chickens too.）」
「Thanks, Koro-chan, but we don't need that info!」
「（After I went to all the trouble of reading it...）」
「Does that mean this is a reaction to the misanga bracelet?!」
「We're obviously at a disadvantage, being surrounded. Let's flee into the estate!」
But then, when we were about to enter the residence, the situation changed even further.
